name: I Need to Be in Love
source:
You arrive in Moon Town with nothing but uncertainty—your parents are gone, your money is running out, and your future is unclear. What happens next is entirely up to you, train your body. Develop your skills. Build relationships. Choose your career. Fall in love—or manipulate, betray, and take control.

Moon Town is filled with unique characters, hidden motives, and evolving relationships. Whether you seek romance, power, or a fresh start, your decisions will ripple through the town and permanently change your story.
translation:
你到达月亮镇时，除了不确定之外一无所有——你的父母去世了，你的钱用完了，你的未来也不明朗。接下来发生什么完全取决于你，锻炼你的身体。发展你的技能。建立关系。选择你的职业。坠入爱河——或者操纵、背叛、控制。

月亮镇充满了独特的人物、隐藏的动机和不断发展的关系。无论你寻求浪漫、权力还是新的开始，你的决定都会波及整个城镇并永久改变你的故事。
